# opnsense_nginx_limit_request_connection (Data Source)

nginx connection limits (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Access ▸ Connection Limits**, plugin `os-nginx`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx connection limit.

### Read-Only

- `burst` (Number) Burst (HTTP Only).
- `connection_count` (Number) Connection Count (Streams Only).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `limit_zone` (Set of String) Limit Zone.
- `nodelay` (Boolean) No Delay (HTTP Only).
